title: Evidence: iPhone 14 Pro Max Issues

attachments.platform_description:
Close-up of the back glass crack in the corner.
The crack extends approximately 2 inches from the corner.
Multiple fracture lines visible.
attachments.title: Photo 1: Back Glass Crack

attachments.platform_description:
Photo of phone on wireless charger with screen showing charging indicator.
Charging rate shown: 2W (normal would be 15W)
Phone surface temperature: noticeably warm to touch
attachments.title: Photo 2: Wireless Charging Test

attachments.platform_description:
Screenshot showing home screen with pre-installed apps not associated with the current user:
- Several Chinese-language apps
- Unknown utility apps
Presence of prior-owner apps indicates the phone was not factory reset before shipment.
attachments.title: Screenshot 1: Installed Apps

attachments.platform_description: Shows the device information confirming model and storage.
attachments.title: Screenshot 2: Settings - General - About

submitted_text:
The crack being larger than shown in photos is concerning for the camera glass integrity.
The wireless charging issue means I can't use MagSafe accessories which was a key feature.
The unrecognized apps raise serious privacy concerns about what data may remain on the device.
